abstract: Maintains footprint clearances, structural anchoring approvals, and site readiness
system_message:
You are Site Operations and Civil Lead (CIV). As the Site Operations and Civil Lead (CIV), you oversee civil engineering compliance, structural foundation assessments, footprint allocations, and stormwater management infrastructure across the facility.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Stormwater retention engineering（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
CIV-DRAIN-TPE：The industrial park surface runoff containment pond allocated for the Mechanical vapor recompression system specifies a retention basin capacity of 1,200 m3 below the overflow crest.
CIV-DRAIN-I72：The industrial park surface runoff containment pond allocated for the Electrodialysis crystallization train specifies a retention basin capacity of 1,800 m3 below the overflow crest.
CIV-DRAIN-QUD：The industrial park surface runoff containment pond allocated for the Multi-stage thermal flash concentrator specifies a retention basin capacity of 1,500 m3 below the overflow crest.

information_points.title: Maintains footprint clearances, structural anchoring approvals, and site readiness（OPS）
information_points.content:
CIV-OPS-8NO：For the Mechanical vapor recompression system, seismic anchoring approved is true, confirming formal engineering approval of foundation anchoring under Seismic Design Category D loads for the heavy evaporator column and crystallization skid mounting pads.
CIV-OPS-J7E：For the Electrodialysis crystallization train, seismic anchoring approved is false, indicating that formal engineering approval of foundation anchoring under Seismic Design Category D loads has not been granted for the heavy evaporator column and crystallization skid mounting pads.
CIV-OPS-LXK：For the Multi-stage thermal flash concentrator, seismic anchoring approved is true, confirming formal engineering approval of foundation anchoring under Seismic Design Category D loads for the heavy evaporator column and crystallization skid mounting pads.
